text: レッドも　まけずに　ポケモンを　たたかわせて　そだてると　いいぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　たたかわせて
そだてると　いいぞ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せ put into たたかう says you make someone else do it. ポケモンを たたかわせて = 'making your Pokémon battle'.

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by と いい is friendly advice: 'it would be good to do this'. そだてると いい = 'you should raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ずに after a verb means 'without doing' it. まけずに = 'without losing', here 'so you don't fall behind'.
